newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian late rubber higher on Tokyo rises.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian late rubber higher on Tokyo rises.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 offer prices were slightly higher in late trading on Tuesday due to rises in Tokyo, traders said.
"Offer prices have improved a bit after rises in Tokyo, but there were no buyers at all," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were higher at 47.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Belawan and Palembang for July/August shipment, 46.50 fob Padang, 46.75 fob Surabaya, 46.00 fob Pontianak and 46.25 fob Jambi.
They said supply of raw material was tight in the local market, but this failed to lift poor market sentiment because of the absence of buyers.
